fields.subject: SQL Server Provider Services
fields.trigger: a provider-neutral caller prepares a query contract with a destination command, source SQL parameters, requested parameter names, and optional replacement values
fields.response: copy every source SQL parameter when requested parameter names are absent or empty, setting each destination SqlParameter's CompareInfo, DbType, Direction, IsNullable, LocaleId, Offset, ParameterName, Precision, Scale, Size, SourceColumn, SourceColumnNullMapping, SqlDbType, SqlValue, TypeName and Value from the matching source parameter, then overwriting Value with the replacement value when one is supplied for that parameter name; otherwise, for each requested parameter name, normalize it and copy the first source parameter whose name equals the normalized name (later source parameters with the same name are ignored) using the same per-property copy and value-replacement rule, and when no source parameter's name equals the normalized name, throw a ParameterNotFoundException constructed with that normalized name
fields.postcondition: the destination command contains exactly one SQL parameter per requested name, in the requested-selection order, unless a requested name normalizes to a value absent from the source collection, in which case construction fails with a ParameterNotFoundException naming that normalized value
